module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Liquidity Provider Rejection on Single Child Order During Fast Market
precondition: Fast market causes LP to reject 1 of 20 child tickets.
expected: Rejection isolated; auto-retry routes child order to secondary LP bridge within 100ms; remaining 19 orders fill.
coverage_note: Requires LP partial-fill, depth, rejection, or routing fault injection; these dedicated accounts are B-book and no LP simulator was supplied.
